overview_description.description: The Luxury is a global concierge company founded in 2014 by Constantin Catalin Dascalu. The company is headquartered in London and operates 6 offices worldwide. The Luxury is a member-only "luxury lifestyle management service" that provides concierge services including travel bookings, restaurant recommendations, and access to events. The Luxury includes 4 brand services, including Lifestyle Management, Influencers Talent Agency, Retail, and The Luxury Academy. In 2018, the company was estimated to have about 2500 subscribers, including 12 billionaires.
